title: Wolf Companion
html:
Wolf Companion is a variant of  Ranger's Companion which is a Subclass Feature of Rangers learned immediately upon choosing the Beast Master subclass. This ability allows the Beast Master to call upon their animal companion to fight and aid them in combat.

Description

Summon a wolf that can inflict devastating wounds and knock down enemies with its  Lunging Bite.

Pack Tactics
When an ally is within 3 m (10 ft) of your target and is not  Incapacitated, your  Attack Rolls against the target have  Advantage.
Prey's Scent
You deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's  Hunter's Mark.

Your wolf companion has 11 Hit Points and 13  Armour Class. It is also proficient in Stealth and Perception.

Classes:

This action is a variation of:
Ranger's Companion

Notes

  • The summoned wolf companion derives its name from Latin:[1]
    • Lupus – wolf
    • Lupus Major – great wolf
    • Lupus Optumus – best wolf

Footnotes

  1. ↑ Notably Major and Optumus are incompatible inflections. Optumus is an alternate form of optimus, the superlative of bonus, while Major is an alternative form of maior, the comparative degree of magnus. The correct sequence would have either been Lupus -> Lupus Maior/Major -> Lupus Maximus, or Lupus -> Lupus Melior -> Lupus Optumus/Optimus.
